Sahil Pandey
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Bangalore
sahil.pandey539@example.com | +91 9309431039

Experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist focusing on high-volume and niche hiring for technology and product teams. Skilled at end-to-end recruitment processes, stakeholder management, and improving time-to-hire through structured sourcing and evaluation. Available with a 15 days notice period.

Experience
Freshworks — Jun 2023 - May 2026
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote/Onsite hybrid)
- Managed full-cycle Talent Acquisition for product and engineering roles, closing 120+ positions across APAC with an average time-to-fill reduction from 42 to 28 days by optimizing interview workflows and leveraging targeted sourcing channels (Recruitment).
- Designed and scaled a campus and early-career recruitment program that resulted in 45 hires in two cohorts and increased offer acceptance rate from 72% to 86% (Talent Acquisition).
- Implemented Confluence-based recruitment playbooks and scorecards, standardizing interview rubrics and improving hiring manager satisfaction scores by 18% (Confluence, Recruitment).
- Collaborated with hiring managers in Agile delivery teams to prioritize hiring sprints and align hiring cadence with product release cycles, reducing backlog of open roles by 30% (Agile, Talent Acquisition).

Nykaa — Feb 2022 - May 2023
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Onsite)
- Drove end-to-end Recruitment for e-commerce and supply chain functions, filling 80+ roles including specialized technical and operations positions with a 82% offer acceptance rate (Recruitment).
- Built a passive sourcing pipeline using targeted outreach and Linux-focused technical forums to hire engineers with specific infra skills, decreasing reliance on external agencies by 40% (Linux, Recruitment).
- Introduced structured debriefs and Confluence hiring templates that cut decision time by 25% and improved cross-functional alignment (Confluence, Talent Acquisition).
- Partnered with Agile squads to forecast hiring needs tied to quarterly roadmaps, enabling proactive hiring plans and reducing urgent requisitions by 35% (Agile, Talent Acquisition).

Projects
- Interview Playbook Repository: Created a Confluence-based repository of role-specific interview guides and evaluation templates used across talent teams, reducing interviewer prep time by ~50%.
- Passive Sourcing Campaign: Ran targeted outreach campaigns on niche forums and technical communities to build a 300+ candidate pool for Linux and infra roles, converting 12% into hires.

Skills
Recruitment: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition
Tools & Collaboration: Confluence
Technical & Methods: Linux, Agile

B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
